# ZIP member: company/acme-profile.txt

Acme Bank is headquartered at 100 Market Street. The website is https://example.com/acme.

Jane Doe joined Acme Bank as Chief Compliance Officer in 2021.

---

# ZIP member: company/leadership/current-officers.md

# Officers

John Smith is currently listed as Chief Compliance Officer as of 2025-10-15.

This may supersede older leadership records.

---

# ZIP member: company/ownership/employment-agency-network.md

# Employment Agency Network Ownership Timeline

Northstar Staffing acquired Harbor Temps on 2022-04-01.

Harbor Temps merged with Lakeside Workforce to form Harbor Lakeside Workforce on 2023-08-15.

In 2024, the healthcare staffing division was split into CareShift Partners.

As of 2025-11-20, Acme Bank vendor records list Northstar Staffing as the parent company for CareShift Partners.

A later supplier portal export dated 2026-02-10 lists CareShift Partners as independently owned.

These ownership facts are time-sensitive and should not be treated as current without refresh.

---

# ZIP member: policies/access-control.md

# Access Control

Contractor SharePoint access must be reviewed every 90 days.

The current escalation threshold is $25,000 as of 2026-05-31.

---

# ZIP member: policies/archived/old-access-control.md

# Old Policy

The escalation threshold was $10,000 in 2023.

---

The public website for Acme Bank is https://example.com/acme.

components.text_preview: Acme Bank is headquartered at 100 Market Street. The website is https://example.com/acme.
Jane Doe joined Acme Bank as Chief Compliance Officer in 2021.
# Officers
John Smith is currently listed as Chief Compliance Officer as of 2025-10-15.
This may supersede older leadership records.
# Employment Agency Network Ownership Timeline
Northstar Staffing acquired Harbor Temps on 2022-04-01.
Harbor Temps merged with Lakeside Workforce to form Harbor Lakeside Workforce on 2023-08-15.
In 2024, the healthcare staffing division was split into CareShift Partners.
As of 2025-11-20, Acme Bank vendor records list Northstar Staffing as the parent company for CareShift Partners.
A later supplier portal export dated 2026-02-10 lists CareShift Partners as independently owned.
These ownership facts are time-sensitive and should not be treated as current without refresh.
# Access Control
Contractor SharePoint access must be reviewed every 90 days.
The current escalation threshold is $25,000 as of 2026-05-31.
# Old Policy
The escalation threshold was $10,000 in 2023.
The public website for Acme Bank is https://example.com/acme.
